description: This file contains test cases for the DELETE API endpoint of the Accounts module in the V8 version of the SuiteCRM project. It verifies proper deletion of an account record and handles error scenarios when the record is not found.

classes.name: DeleteModuleCest
classes.description: A test class that contains methods to test the deletion of an Accounts module via API in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method run before each test, logs in using the API tester.

methods.name: shouldWork
methods.description: Tests successful deletion of an account record via DELETE request.

methods.name: shouldNotWork
methods.description: Tests the behavior when attempting to delete a non-existent account record.
